record.dic_text:
01294 B@rakah {be-ra:-kha:'}

與 01293 同;

欽定本 - Berachah 3; 3

陽性專有名詞 人名
比拉迦 = "祝福"
1) 一位便雅憫人, 是大衛的大能勇士之一 (#代上 12:3|)

專有名詞 地名
2) 靠近提哥亞的曠野中的一個村落, 約沙法和其百姓曾聚在此,
   為入侵的摩押人被擊殺潰敗而讚美神 (#代下 20:26|)
record.edic_text:
01294 B@rakah {ber-aw-kaw'}

the same as 01293;

AV - Berachah 3; 3

n pr m
Berachah = "blessing"
1) a Benjamite, one of David's warriors
n pr loc
2) a valley in the wilderness near Tekoa where Jehoshaphat and his
   people assembled to bless Jehovah after the overthrow of the hosts
   of the Moabites
